references.text: The tribes of Reuben and Gad ask to receive the land east of the Jordan as their inheritance, which is the background for their promise in verse 19.
The tribes confirm that they will cross the Jordan armed, while their inheritance remains on the east side of the Jordan.
Confirms that the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and half-tribe of Manasseh had already received their inheritance east of the Jordan.
Moses recounts how the land east of the Jordan was given to Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh as their inheritance.
Joshua reminds the tribes east of the Jordan that their inheritance is on the east side, while they must still help their brothers.
Describes the inheritance received by Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh east of the Jordan.
After the conquest, Joshua sends the tribes back to their inheritance on the east side of the Jordan, as promised.
